new_spots.name: Te Ana – The Caves
new_spots.photo_reason: Real photo (CC BY 2.0) of the Commons-titled cave interior with stalactites and stalagmites; right place (Kaikoura, per file description); the cave interior is the attraction; sharp and well exposed. Wikipedia lead coordinates (-42.4117, 173.6585) match, 2 km south of town on SH1. Bio facts (about 91 m, formerly Maori Leap Cave, reopened late 2025) confirmed in the Wikipedia article.

new_spots.name: Kaikōura Museum
new_spots.photo_reason: Genuine photo of the museum building (shared with library/council, signage reads Kaikoura Museum) with the curved slatted crayfish-pot form visible; a museum photo is the building per IMAGES.md. Flat street-level framing with road in foreground, so weak but passes all four checks. Coordinates match OSM node (-42.4028, 173.6826) and Wikivoyage. kaikoura-museum.co.nz loads titled 'Kaikōura Museum' and is the Wikivoyage-listed official site.

new_spots.name: Point Kean
new_spots.photo_reason: Real photo of a NZ fur seal on rock, described on Commons as the Point Kean fur seal colony; wildlife photo of the animal is acceptable for a seal viewpoint. Close-up and not scenic, so a wider seal-colony shot would be better if one exists, but it passes. Not a near-duplicate: Wikivoyage lists Point Kean Viewpoint separately (-42.4232, 173.7164, Fyffe Quay), about 400 m from the walkway pin, reached by car without doing the walk. Bio facts match Wikivoyage; 'start of the Peninsula Walkway' is consistent with DOC.

new_spots.name: Nin's Bin
new_spots.photo_reason: Real photo of the blue-and-white caravan with NINS BIN lettering, open sign and the ocean beside it; Commons description confirms Half Moon Bay north of Kaikoura. The caravan is the attraction. Overcast sky but it is the genuine, recognisable subject. Coordinates match Wikipedia (-42.2647, 173.8076). Wikipedia confirms the caravan beside SH1 within view of the ocean and the 1977 opening; has a Wikipedia article and Wikivoyage listing, so it clears the bar as a quirky roadside icon. ninsbin.co.nz loads (title 'Crayfish | Nins Bin | Kaikōura') and is the business's own site.

existing_fixes.reason: Do not replace. The proposal itself recommends keeping; the boat ride over the Kaikōura Canyon has no landing place, so the trip is the attraction, and it is Kaikōura's headline experience. Replacing it with 'Kaikōura Canyon' would produce an unvisitable submarine feature.

Swap ticketUrl to https://www.visitheritage.co.nz/visit/upper-south-island/fyffe-house: loaded, title 'Heritage New Zealand - Visit Fyffe House | Kaikōura Attraction', and Wikivoyage lists the same site. Hours are better left as is unless the seasonal hours are verified from the Heritage NZ page, since the Wikivoyage hours are dated.
Add the DOC Kaikōura Peninsula Walkway ticketUrl; page loaded and is the managing agency's page for this track. Existing coordinates unchanged.
